label: preparing
what: A private celebration apparently marking my forty years as mayor, planned for the great hall at eighteen on day 1. The innkeeper's withdrawn request and accepted invitation, together with the secretary's report of two hundred loaves and eight lanterns and checks on private payment, strongly support coordinated preparations. Baker and innkeeper were repeatedly reported together at the bakery. I know of the invitation and suspect its purpose, but have deliberately left the details alone; other helpers are not established.
